content:
Marta: quick idea — introduce an "opaque scope hint" header that signals intent for private/vpc or dedicated-pool routing without leaking workspace ids to the gateway logs. e.g. `X-RW-Scope-Hint: opaque:vpc:xxxx`
Devin: can you sketch the routing semantics? is this authoritative or advisory?
Marta: advisory but high-precedence. flow: 1) auth verify tenant -> 2) check explicit tenant/vpc binding -> 3) if none, check opaque hint -> 4) route to matching private endpoint/dedicated pool if quota + affinity allow, else fallback to hosted with audit event.
Priya: how do we avoid escalation attacks where a user sets a hint to access another tenant's pool? need to ensure hint alone never bypasses tenant binding.
Marta: yep, hint only elevates when the request bearer and request metadata indicate the same org (via token binding). hint -> route only if token.gid == pool.tenant_gid. Otherwise reject or fallback.
Leo: what about telemetry? we'd want a `routing_decision` field that records `hint_used: true|false`, `hint_match_kind: exact|prefix|none`, `fallback_reason` for later analysis.
Marta: exactly. sample telemetry event: `{
  "event": "route.resolve",
  "decision": "hint_matched",
  "hint": "opaque:vpc",
  "fallback": "quota_exceeded"
}`
Samir: console UX: product wants to show a filter like "Requests with scope hints" and a breakdown of successes vs fallbacks. Also an opt-in toggle for strict-hint-mode for partners.
Devin: rollout plan? need canary on eng-only traffic + feature flag + circuit to turn off fallback to test strict mode.
Marta: propose feature flag `routing.opaque_hint.v1` default off, staged enable for internal orgs, then select customers. add unit tests for matcher and e2e with fake vpc endpoint.
Priya: edgecases: 1) hint prefix collisions (opaque:vpc vs opaque:vpc-eu) -> matcher must support longest-prefix and record matched string. 2) quota accounting when hint routes to dedicated pool: charge pool vs hosted? we need clear accounting path.
Leo: also need to scrub hint from logs that go to external analytics but keep hashed hint in house. hashing scheme: `sha256(workspace_id + salt)` stored as `hint_hash` in telemetry.
Samir: required tasks: 1) gateway matcher impl (Dev) 2) auth binding check (Auth team) 3) telemetry fields + console filter (Observability + Console) 4) rollout plan + docs (DevEx + PM)
Marta: I'll open a tracking PR and add a design doc. quick config example to discuss:
```yaml
matchers:
  - name: opaque-hint-vpc
    header: X-RW-Scope-Hint
    match_type: prefix
    prefixes: ["opaque:vpc:"]
    precedence: 800
    action: prefer_route: private_endpoint
```
Devin: looks good. add a test matrix for: matching, mismatch-with-token, quota-fallback, prefix-overlap, telemetry flags.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway/opaque-hint-prototype -> canary cluster at 2026-04-02T02:00Z :rocket:
Priya: one more: add audit log entry for `hint_accepted` vs `hint_rejected` with reason (auth, quota, affinity). security will want that.
Marta: agreed. thanks all — I'll start the doc and assign follow-ups. :thumbsup:
